files.reason: Detect CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER_ID==ILUVATAR: set MIN_GPU_ARCH=60 (bypass NV numeric-arch clamping, disable fully-fused MLP, force CutlassMLP); translate nvcc-only flags (-Xcompiler=, -Xcudafe, --use_fast_math, --extended-lambda, --expt-relaxed-constexpr) to clang++-compatible forms; add -Wno-unknown-cuda-version / -Wno-deprecated-declarations.
Guard the __CUDA_ARCH__ >= MIN_GPU_ARCH*10 static_assert with !defined(__ILUVATAR__); ivcore11 misreports __CUDA_ARCH__=300 but is fp16-capable.
lane_id() uses portable __nvvm_read_ptx_sreg_laneid() on __ILUVATAR__ instead of NV '%laneid' PTX (rejected by corex clang backend).
Enable fp16 intrinsics (__hfma, atomicAdd(__half2), half2 vector specializations) on __ILUVATAR__ (were gated behind __CUDA_ARCH__>=600).
Downgrade the 'GPU does not support virtual memory' log_warning to log_debug so warning-as-failure test hooks are not tripped by the expected ivcore11 fallback.

Guard the __CUDACC_VER_MAJOR__/MINOR__ static_assert with !defined(__ILUVATAR__); make cuda_supports_virtual_memory() probe cuMemGetAllocationGranularity+cuMemCreate (cached) instead of trusting the misleading device attribute (cuMemCreate returns IX_ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED on ivcore11).
Add an early 'return;' after the supports_jit_fusion() skip guard so the JIT-only test case skips cleanly on ivcore11 (cc<75) instead of constructing a CudaRtcKernel and throwing.
Replace CUDA texture object sampling (tex2D/cudaCreateTextureObject, unavailable on ivcore11) with a manual bilinear sampler over the plain RGBA float device buffer.
Same texture -> manual bilinear sampler replacement as the sample.
Qualify RM/CM as tcnn::RM / tcnn::CM to avoid ambiguity with the global RM/CM injected by corex __clang_cuda_ivcorex_intrinsics.h.
Submodule (see changes/cutlass.patch): provide a __cvta_generic_to_shared shim (low-32-bit shared-window offset) under __ILUVATAR__.

Submodule (see changes/cutlass.patch): neutralize NV-only global/shared ld/st PTX with generic C++; reconstruct the real shared pointer as (smem_base()|offset) since ivcore11 shared generic pointers carry a nonzero high-32-bit window base.
Submodule (see changes/cutlass.patch): shared_load_op<8>/<16> load directly through the real generic pointer instead of NV ld.shared.v4.b32 (invalid instruction on ivcore11).
